test_item:
KeyInstall shall store status of imported keys to the predefined location in the internal storage: partition in the secure storage.
(installstate file contains INSTALLED (2))
pre: 1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
er: 1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file> output shows the installstate value 2
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-006 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: installstate value; rule 2 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
